name: ARGOS Domains category enrichment source inventory
purpose: Offline source discovery for site-rating-app to enrich canonical Domains/ARGDOM3 category taxonomy; not live router feeds, TI confidence or auto Block.
taxonomy: src/argos_site_rating/taxonomy.py (site-rating-app); do not invent new categories or rewrite existing accepted labels
rating_database: site-rating-app/data/site-rating.db (only reviewed resolved domain/category to ARGDOM3)

already_integrated_or_used.label: UT1 Toulouse topic categorization
already_integrated_or_used.notes: Use mapped category as hint; lists not all equally maintained; primary actively maintained category is adult. Existing pipeline already maps numerous UT1 labels.

already_integrated_or_used.label: Block List Project lists
already_integrated_or_used.source_license: Unlicense stated by project; upstream attribution review
already_integrated_or_used.notes: Existing adapter already has categories for advertising, malware, phishing, piracy, gambling, social platforms, telemetry. Aggregate outputs include upstream lists; avoid duplicate confidence and automatic Block.

already_integrated_or_used.label: v2fly domain-list-community geosite categories
already_integrated_or_used.source_license: MIT claimed by existing pipeline; validate upstream per-list
already_integrated_or_used.notes: Already used for media/games/social/ecommerce/finance/education/cryptocurrency signals. Region, geolocation and routing lists are not content categories.

already_integrated_or_used.label: Wikidata official websites and entities
already_integrated_or_used.notes: Already integrated; new ROR and OpenAlex records often overlap entity IDs and must not be counted as independent validation.

already_integrated_or_used.label: Cloudflare Radar top-domain ranking
already_integrated_or_used.notes: A top-rank is NOT a genre or quality label; Cloudflare per-domain category lookup is separate and not yet supported.

already_integrated_or_used.label: Tranco ranked domains
already_integrated_or_used.notes: Popularity ranking is not an editorial category.

additional_candidates.expected_scale: ~2.9 million site entries advertised; verify actual export before import

additional_candidates.license: CC0 snapshot; verify API access terms
Cloudflare provider terms; redistribution not cleared

policy.matched_url_and_host_semantics: Preserve exact URL/path and subdomain vs suffix ownership. More-specific verified subdomains may override registrable-domain category. Do not propagate a third-party hosted path to a shared parent domain.
policy.data_normalization: IDNA/punycode, public suffix awareness, canonical Unicode, URL host extraction, validate TLD; prevent localhost/private IP and broken domains.
policy.provenance: Retain source_id, source_version, observed_at, original_url, original_category, mapping_version, rights, issuer, role, expiry/freshness, and raw digest. Suppress duplicate votes from same upstream lineage.
policy.conflict_policy: Source evidence remains a hint until independent page/content/entity verification. Preserve multi-label evidence and classify site primary purpose separately from malware/ad-risk overlays.
required_acceptance: No present source duplicated as a new independent vote
All candidate sources remain discovery_only and offline
No rating database mutation until calibrated/authorized adapter
No publisher rights inferred from public access
No silent truncation and no false positives from parent/subdomain mismatches
Test overlapping ROR/OpenAlex/Wikidata and BLP/HaGeZi/UT1 input lineage
Only resolved domain-category rows exported; unknown and conflicting stay unresolved

excluded_or_deferred.why: Closed predecessor of Curlie; stale and overlapping lineage, not a second independent database
Already domain discovery; rankings are not category labels
Security/ads signal is not the site's primary topic. Feed Manager already has separate DNS lists and the site-rating-app already uses UT1/BLP.
API access and embedding/redistribution rights must be approved before integration, not scraped as public bulk datasets
Vocabulary crosswalk is useful but provides no domain-category pairs by itself
